description: Checklist for new technical institution establishment applications under AICTE regulations. Requirements are more stringent than EOA.

required_documents.name: Affidavit on Stamp Paper
required_documents.description: Notarized affidavit on non-judicial stamp paper of minimum Rs. 100 as per prescribed format

required_documents.name: State Government NOC
required_documents.description: No Objection Certificate from the State Government / UT Administration with specific approval for courses

required_documents.name: Trust Deed / Society Registration
required_documents.description: Registered Trust Deed / Society Registration certificate / Company incorporation certificate

required_documents.name: Society Registration Certificate
required_documents.description: Certificate of registration under the Societies Registration Act / Trust Act / Companies Act

required_documents.name: Land Ownership / Lease Document
required_documents.description: Registered sale deed or lease deed (minimum 30 years) in the name of the trust / society / company

required_documents.name: Approved Building Plan
required_documents.description: Building plan approved by competent authority with detailed layout of classrooms, labs, library, admin block

required_documents.name: Fire Safety Certificate
required_documents.description: Fire safety certificate from the Chief Fire Officer certifying compliance for the proposed building

required_documents.name: Audited Financial Statement
required_documents.description: Audited balance sheet of the trust / society for the last 3 financial years, certified by a CA

required_documents.name: Undertaking by Promoter / Trust
required_documents.description: Undertaking by the promoter / trust to comply with all AICTE norms including land, infrastructure, faculty

required_documents.name: AICTE Application Fee Receipt
required_documents.description: Receipt of non-refundable application processing fee paid to AICTE

required_documents.name: Detailed Infrastructure Plan
required_documents.description: Detailed report on proposed infrastructure including labs, workshops, computing facilities, library, hostels

required_documents.name: Anti-Ragging Undertaking
required_documents.description: Affidavit from the promoter body confirming anti-ragging measures as per UGC guidelines

required_documents.name: Proposed Faculty Recruitment Plan
required_documents.description: Detailed recruitment plan for faculty with proposed qualifications meeting AICTE norms

required_documents.name: University Affiliation Letter
required_documents.description: Letter of intent / NOC from the affiliating university for proposed courses

required_fields.description: Proposed name of the new institution
Name of the sponsoring trust, society, or Section 8 company
Full name of the chairman or president of the promoter body
University from which affiliation is sought
Complete address of the proposed site
State or Union Territory of the proposed institution
City or district of the proposed location
6-digit postal PIN code of the proposed site
List of proposed programmes with course name, level, duration, and intake
Total proposed student intake across all programmes
Number of faculty proposed to be recruited before commencement
Total land area available at the proposed site in acres
Total built-up area (ready or under construction) in square feet
Fixed Deposit Receipt amount in the name of the trust / society as per AICTE norms
Academic year in which the institution proposes to start admissions
Official contact email of the promoter body
Distance in km to the nearest existing AICTE-approved institution

compliance_rules.description: Faculty to student ratio must not exceed 1:15 for new institutions
Minimum 5 acres for engineering colleges; 2.5 acres within municipal limits of metropolitan cities
Minimum 25,000 sq. ft. built-up area ready before first admissions
Valid fire safety certificate is mandatory before any admissions
Minimum FDR of Rs. 1.5 crore for engineering; Rs. 50 lakhs for management / pharmacy
Promoter trust / society must demonstrate minimum net worth
Minimum 8,000 titles for a new engineering college
Minimum one computer for every 2 students for new institutions
Promoter must commit to full UGC anti-ragging compliance
Building must include ramps, accessible toilets, elevators for differently-abled
Building must be 100% complete with occupancy certificate before first admissions
Promoter must not have any other pending or rejected application in the current cycle
Land must be converted to non-agricultural / institutional use with proper documentation
Promoter must commit to publishing mandatory disclosure on institution website
